description:
## Goal

Eliminate repeated root-granular transport derivation caused by subscribing aggregate products to intermediate settlement waves. Root products may join exact per-member answers for final packaging, but they must not rebuild a root inventory whenever any member advances.

## Researched signal at 82870f5bb

After the reactive RuntimeDemand and retained macro-product cutovers, one fresh debug-interp request for 00420_enum_take_drop_split still has:

- OutgoingEdgeFrontier: 48 settlements / 47 displacements.
- IncomingInputRelations: 48 settlements / 47 displacements.
- IncomingInputSlot: 342 evaluations / 296 settlements / 161 displacements.

The frontier is a growing PullSession request registry. Each first outgoing-edge request invalidates it; the root relation joins every publisher; every input slot reads that whole-root aggregate. A focused RED regression proves an unrelated outgoing request displaces an already retained slot answer.

Displacement telemetry means a memo answer or pending derivation was removed for reproduction, not exclusively abandoned in-flight work. Necessary changed-answer reproduction must be distinguished by exact cause from unrelated aggregate churn.

## Chosen ownership and required collapse

RuntimeDemand already owns the exact ExecutableFacts and callable-flow inputs used to derive each source edge. Publish InputSlot source contributions there, using the existing generic ContributionMap and the scheduler-owned per-publisher output frontier. Caller completion owns its outgoing edges; target completion claims its own empty input slots so absence of caller sources is a readable, precisely owned empty answer. Waiting extends; concluding replaces only that publisher. Equal joined values retain their existing Rc and fact revision.

World IncomingInputSlot is the sole relation authority. CallableConstruction consumes the exact settled slot fact directly. Delete the one-fact IncomingInputSlot product as well as OutgoingEdgeFrontier, IncomingInputRelations, OutgoingInputEdges, OrderedIncomingInputs, the request registry and the materialization-only outgoing prerequisite. No projection-only compatibility product or extra relation registry remains. Batch already-nameable local prerequisites before waiting; do not recreate a root scan.

Prototype evidence before deleting the final slot forwarding product: take/drop slot settlements 296->135 and displacements 161->0, materialized evaluations 696->585, root packaging evaluations 23->19; all three target backend dumps and runtime stdout are byte-identical. These are interim measurements, not final acceptance. Operator-reference has six additional late slot quiescence rounds (32->38, exceeding the existing 34 ceiling); eliminate that prerequisite ladder before delivery. No ceiling increase is authorized.

Before/after traces and canonical backends: /tmp/fz-kdt57-artifact-baseline.Et4zBB; pre-change binary SHA256 b0d190595aeee82165df5e6aa9b608a2838605881ed326fe1d631529febe50d8. Final causal proof belongs in the close record and current docs.

## Output contract

- Outgoing edge and incoming relation state is maintained at the smallest identity that owns the edge or slot.
- One edge movement invalidates only the exact local relation cells and final root readers that consumed it.
- RootBackendProduct assembles the current reachable answer from exact dependencies; it does not subscribe to or rebuild an intermediate whole-root inventory per wave.
- CallableConstruction reads the exact settled IncomingInputSlot fact; prerequisite discovery must not introduce an avoidable readiness ladder or race the ascent that creates source edges.
- Equal local answers preserve generations and produce no displacement.
- World retains exact relation facts and persistent root sessions retain unaffected consumer products across requests.

## Strategy

1. Pin unrelated source-edge invalidation RED against the old aggregate model.
2. Publish exact slot contributions from the existing RuntimeDemand formula and reuse contribution ownership/finality.
3. Make callable consumers read exact slot facts directly, with already-nameable prerequisites batched.
4. Delete every root-granular relation authority, redundant forwarding product and artificial prerequisite.
5. Prove exact replacement, waiting retention, empty slots, shared allocation, root isolation and semantic/artifact parity.

Do not cache a root scan, add a second frontier registry, or split a product without an exact owner and consumer.

## TDD and acceptance

- A one-edge addition, removal, and equal reproduction each have exact slot revision/allocation and consumer evaluation/displacement counts, attributed to the precise moved fact.
- Redefining one reached leaf reevaluates only relations in its transitive product-reader closure.
- Redefining an unreachable function performs zero transport-relation work for the root.
- Deleted frontier/relation products emit no work. Every remaining consumer displacement names an exact necessary dependency movement; no unrelated aggregate invalidation or avoidable prerequisite race remains.
- Root-level packaging runs only when its final reachable answer changes.
- Canonical programs and all three execution doors remain identical.

## Checks and documentation

Run focused product dependency tests, persistent-root edit tests, causal reports on all target fixtures, full library, single-threaded matrix, interp/run/build parity, and clippy with warnings denied. Update fact-engine, pipeline, transport documentation, performance instrumentation, and northstar; remove any superseded aggregate product and telemetry.

## Current review gate

The independent finality blocker fz-tfn.41 is delivered as acb54dd81. Preliminary cold review required replacing presence-only consumer assertions with exact work evidence. The strengthened retained tests now pass: equal producer reproduction causes zero exact input-owner evaluations, displacements and waits; one edge addition or removal causes exactly one evaluation and one retained-answer displacement, with zero waits. The moved direct-fact dependency intersection is exactly IncomingInputSlot; source counts1->2->1, one revision increment per edit, shared equal allocation/generation, and independent-root zero work remain pinned. No count relaxation was needed. The final formatted test source d92b357f15bdfcb326f36fc8b095e5a336c39e53947ff284c42a1449e0c698a5 and production residual passed cold scoped source review. An initial combined verification attempt was invalid: a shared Cargo target across the isolated .41 worktree and primary worktree reused a stale fz2 binary despite reporting fresh. Its trace still emitted the deleted product variants. Discard those .final traces and CLI result as .57 evidence. Rebuild only the fz package outputs in primary, then prove deleted variants absent from fresh traces and rerun focused/full gates. No source changes are lost; standalone .41 verification used its independently checked exact source snapshot. This is not yet delivery approval.

## Fresh-build verification

The rebuilt primary fz2 hash is 94a89717a315f0e322870870e8bac22e2746a54cb9c589362560e562fd5fa8e7. Use .verified.jsonl/.verified.backend files under /tmp/fz-kdt57-artifact-baseline.Et4zBB; discarded .final traces are stale. Range, predicate and take/drop verified backend dumps are byte-identical to independently captured .12 baselines. Operator verified backend is byte-identical to operator.after.backend (the early .57 prototype, not an independently captured .41 backend); its before/after causal comparison uses operator41.jsonl. Deleted relation-product kinds emit zero work. Relative to standalone .41, operator formula350/quiescence14 unchanged, products398->378 exactly delete twenty intermediate answers; callable-input cached resume for function178/arrow116/slot2 drops2->1. Take/drop formula4233/quiescence201 unchanged; Materialized evaluations696->500, CallableConstruction5504->5292 with displacement1->0 and settlements5051->5050, root packaging evaluations23->19, and all678 evaluations/631 settlements of the four deleted relation kinds disappear. CLI pin supplement accounts for23 new slot-fact readiness transitions without additional arbitration; full fresh library/matrix/CLI gates remain running. Verified traces include one extra cache-only backend dump request, which must not be confused with compiler work.

## Final local gate supplement

Fresh matrix531/531, CLI30/30, runtime210/210 and doctest/format gates pass. Initial full fresh library had1842 passes, one old native-root count assertion failure, six preexisting ignores. Cold-native product evaluations81->79 remove exactly the main and definition-macro OutgoingInputEdges requests; old materialization unconditionally requested each. The corrected test pins two successfully materialized distinct roots including main, while preserving unchanged exact work starts20/2/24 and all lowering/reuse/Rc/generation/edit contracts. Filtered test passes; cold reviewer approved this supplement and CLI pins. Final full serial library rerun passes1843/0fail/6preexisting ignores. Normal commit hooks pass fmt, workspace check and strict all-target clippy.
